normal.name: Arda Kılıçdağı
normal.text: My AYN Thor is officially a GabeBoy now 😆 I booted a SteamOS-like Linux distro, Armada OS, alongside stock Android. Backed up the bootloader and set up a full dual-boot configuration. Linux runs from the microSD card. This is desktop mode, GameMode is exactly same as SteamOS full screen mode. Even just having access to GE-Proton builds (which aren't available on Android :/) makes this worthwhile on its own. #ayn #aynthor #gabeboy #armadaos #retrogaming #linuxgaming #gamingonlinux
normal.media: image: ayn thor, running armada os, for a steam-deck likle gaming experience. Showing desktop mode.

normal.name: Wolf Munroe ☎
normal.text: Another Saturday and more #Pathfinder1e #Ustalav. We picked up right where the previous session ended. The party found a strong ghoul (CR 6) grappled in hardened ectoplasmic webbing. They underestimated it because it was "just" a ghoul so one of them still managed to get bit and contract ghoul fever. The party then fought a scribbling allip (CR 4), the source of the ectoplasmic webs. The allip hit the rogue and dealt 2d6 sanity damage. #P1e #PathfinderRPG #PFRPG #TTRPG #GameNight
